objects.description: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has attempted to get users to click on a link pointing to a malicious HTML file leading to follow-on malicious content.(Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024)
